hypothesis: Coverage-aware three-valued completion improves trustworthiness of FULFILLED claims without reducing official state-production success.
change: Terminal completion aggregation only: FULFILLED, UNFULFILLED, UNKNOWN plus gold-free source-coverage and formula-representation evidence adequacy.
control: Prior uncapped Arm D development run
treatment: Arm D with coverage-aware three-valued completion

deviations.description: 250,000 tokens is an operational emergency ceiling, not a research token budget.
Provider nondeterminism produced three paired official gains and three paired losses despite temperature zero and stable aggregate pass rate.

interpretation: Completion recognition improved materially while aggregate state production remained stable. Observation coverage and evaluation calibration were a real bottleneck, but contract specification, production variance, and no-progress remain substantial.
next_experiment: Do not run full A/B/C/D yet: investigate the increase from one to two detected preservation violations and improve independent source coverage without goldens.
